[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Gurin''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] officer who had command of a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Gurin led the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|fleet]] in [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Corellia (starship)|''Corellia'']] to investigate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sebaddon]]. [[Droid/Legends|Droid]]-maker [[Lema Xandret]] launched eight [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] filled with [[Fastbreeder|hex droids]] from Sebaddon as an answer. Only one missile survived intact and penetrated ''Corellia''{{'s}} hull. Gurin, unaware of hexes droids threat, quickly assured the participants of the mission that the cruiser had remained intact. Hexes then took control of the ship, while [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Shigar Konshi]] tried to contact Gurin to tell him to evacuate the ship, but the commander was already killed in the attack before he could escape. He was replaced by [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Pipalidi]].
